proves: RFC 0009 1. claims organizations have 'all the properties of entities: durable by default, event-sourced state, stable identity, migration contracts'. The entity body surface is inherited wholesale: `version: N` and `migration from 1 to 2 { state => { ... } }` (RFC 0008) parse and run inside an `organization` declaration, and the organization behaves as a normal actor (send set(7), get -> 7).
